questions.prompt: On Ideogram, what gives the same or a very close result again?

options.text: The same seed with a brand-new prompt
options.explanation: Ideogram says a change to a key idea in the prompt gives a different image, even with the same seed.

options.text: Same prompt, model, settings and seed
options.explanation: Right. Ideogram says all four together give the same or a very close result.

options.text: The same seed on a different model
options.explanation: Ideogram warns that switching models gives a different image even with the same seed.

questions.prompt: In diffusers, what does a higher guidance_scale do?

options.text: Follows the prompt more, at the cost of image quality
options.explanation: Right. Diffusers says a higher guidance_scale gives images more aligned with the prompt, at the expense of lower image quality.

options.text: Runs more clean-up steps, so the image takes longer
options.explanation: That is num_inference_steps. Guidance is about how closely the prompt is followed.

options.text: Fixes the seed so every run gives the same picture
options.explanation: The seed is set with a Generator. Guidance does not fix the starting noise.

questions.prompt: BFL offers preview and fixed FLUX.2 endpoints. Which one fits a job that must repeat its results?

options.text: flux-2-pro-preview, because the newest model is the most stable
options.explanation: BFL says preview endpoints are where the latest improvements land first, so the model under them changes.

options.text: flux-2-pro, a fixed snapshot that BFL says will not change
options.explanation: Right. BFL calls flux-2-pro a fixed snapshot, suitable for workflows that require reproducibility.

options.text: Either one, because the seed alone decides the picture
options.explanation: The seed sets the start. If the model under it changes, the picture can change too.
